from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """Diluted earnings per share reported in one company's financial report."""
    company: str = Field(description="Company name as named in this document")
    diluted_eps: float = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value for the period")
    unit: str = Field(description="Unit of EPS, e.g., '元/股' or 'yuan per share'")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period this EPS covers, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text line containing the EPS value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEPSRecord]
